description: This file defines the Conditional class providing implementation for various conditional statistical functions like AVERAGEIF, COUNTIF, MAXIFS, etc., as well as internal utility methods for building criteria and database arrays. It serves as a core part of the calculation engine for statistical conditional functions in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: A class providing static methods for calculating conditional statistical functions such as AVERAGEIF, COUNTIF, MAXIFS, etc., with internal helpers for building criteria and data arrays.

methods.name: AVERAGEIF
methods.description: Returns the average of cells that meet a single condition.

methods.name: AVERAGEIFS
methods.description: Returns the average of cells that meet multiple conditions.

methods.name: COUNTIF
methods.description: Counts the number of cells that meet a single condition.

methods.name: COUNTIFS
methods.description: Counts the number of cells that meet multiple conditions.

methods.name: MAXIFS
methods.description: Returns the maximum value within a range that meets specified conditions.

methods.name: MINIFS
methods.description: Returns the minimum value within a range that meets specified conditions.

methods.name: SUMIF
methods.description: Sums cells that meet a single condition.

methods.name: SUMIFS
methods.description: Sums cells that meet multiple conditions.

methods.name: buildConditionSet
methods.description: Helper method to construct condition sets for criteria matching.

methods.name: buildConditionSetForValueRange
methods.description: Helper method to construct condition sets tailored for value ranges.

methods.name: buildConditions
methods.description: Internal method to assemble conditions from argument pairs.

methods.name: buildDatabase
methods.description: Constructs a database array from given arguments.

methods.name: buildDatabaseWithValueRange
methods.description: Constructs a database array incorporating the value range for calculations.

methods.name: buildDataSet
methods.description: Internal method to assemble datasets for evaluation.

methods.name: databaseFromRangeAndValue
methods.description: Creates a database array from a data range and optional value range.
